# Šport & Body Terapia

> Professional physiotherapy clinic in Dubnica nad Váhom, Slovakia, led by André Heynes — 25+ years of international experience in musculoskeletal, sports injury, and headache disorder rehabilitation. Bilingual (SK/EN), evidence-based, active recovery focused (PEACE & LOVE protocol).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, practitioner, and contact.
- [About](/about): André Heynes — biography, qualifications, international journey.
- [Blog](/blog): Bilingual articles and patient guides on pain, recovery, and rehabilitation.
- [Medical Disclaimer](/medical-disclaimer): Clinical scope and disclaimer.
